name: How can an ADU increase my property value and potential rental income?

mainEntity.name: How can an ADU increase my property value and potential rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ADU significantly enhances property value by adding livable square footage and an additional income-generating unit. For potential renters, an ADU offers an independent living space, which can command competitive rental rates, providing a steady stream of income. The added housing option makes your property more attractive to a wider range of buyers in the future, especially in competitive markets like Studio City or Encino.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADUs increase property value by adding livable space and can generate rental income, making your property more attractive to buyers and renters.
